Alex (New Hire): Hi all, just onboarded today — the Orientation invite on my calendar says 09:00 but there's no Zoom URL and timezone shows PST even though I'm in CET. Is this the EU session? If I miss it, where will the recording be?

Maya (People Ops): Welcome Alex! That's supposed to be the EU recurrence. Looks like a template timezone bug. Can you paste the event ID from the invite details? Recordings are published to Confluence (New Hires) within ~24h.

Alex (New Hire): Event ID is 992001. Thanks.

Leo - IT: I patched event 992001: added the join URL and changed base timezone to Europe/Paris. Refresh your calendar. Zoom: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/555222333

calendar-bot: Event 992001 updated by Leo - IT (timezone set to Europe/Paris).

Alex (New Hire): Link is visible now, and title shows CET. Thanks everyone for the quick help!

Maya (People Ops): We'll also update the event titles to include region/timezone so future hires don't get confused. :sparkles:
